nodes.label: Population, Token View, Installation, Counterpart, Interpretation
nodes.statement: Distinguish E0 population/session profile, E1 finite same-token view, E2 actual same-token installed Anchor-Bind-Use relation, E3 its C1 experiential structural counterpart, and E4 a familiar felt-mineness interpretation under independently fixed B_min. No adjacent promotion is automatic, and no level is made a basal-experience gate.
nodes.domain: One selected body-frame candidate and its fallible evidence/interpretation chain; not a universal hierarchy of every conscious organization.
nodes.scope: One selected body-frame candidate and its fallible evidence/interpretation chain; not a universal hierarchy of every conscious organization.
nodes.source_lineage: Typed synthesis of R157 semantic residual, R159 actual relation, R160-R161 population protocol and UCT I physical-witness boundary.
nodes.proof: The five objects have different bearers, quantifiers and evidential roles; the subsequent exact counterexamples refute two automatic promotions.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The ladder is not a temporal stage theory or a claim that every system passes through all levels.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: For every admitted application, each claimed promotion must state all bridge premises; existence at a lower level alone is insufficient.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: Population/session summaries, one actual P/I/K/D token, finite instrument views, Phi/h counterparts, external referents and reports remain distinct.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Prevent population, mechanism, C1 and familiar-mineness claims from being collapsed while giving a positive route between them.

nodes.label: Population Profile Does Not Identify a Named Token
nodes.statement: A nonconstant binary response vector and a permutation that changes a named coordinate have identical multisets and every permutation-invariant population statistic. Therefore even an exact population profile does not by itself entail that a named actual token installs the candidate relation.
nodes.domain: Finite binary populations of size at least two with a nonconstant response vector; exact enumeration covers sizes two through six.
nodes.scope: Finite binary populations of size at least two with a nonconstant response vector; exact enumeration covers sizes two through six.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary permutation invariance specialized to the R161 population-to-token gap; no new statistical theorem claimed.
nodes.proof: Swap a 1 and 0 while preserving the response multiset. The exact checker finds a named-coordinate-changing permutation for all 114 nonconstant vectors at sizes two through six.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Longitudinal or token-specific measurement can add evidence; this result denies only inference from the population summary alone.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: Every nonconstant binary vector for n>=2 admits the swap; the executable check is bounded to 2<=n<=6.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: A statistic of a population/session family is not a K-relation in a named actual P/I token.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Block the R161 group-profile to actual-token shortcut.

nodes.label: Finite Interface Trace Does Not Identify Installed Use
nodes.statement: The path model r:=b,k:=r,u:=k and bypass model r:=b,k:=r,u:=r agree on all natural binary inputs and every do(r) case, including observed r,k,u, although k mediates u only in the first. A do(k) intervention holding r fixed discriminates them. Hence natural or upstream-intervention traces alone do not entail installed use.
nodes.domain: The declared deterministic binary structural models and intervention semantics only; not a complete neural model.
nodes.scope: The declared deterministic binary structural models and intervention semantics only; not a complete neural model.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary structural-model counterexample specialized to the R159 Use relation; causal mediation is not claimed as new.
nodes.proof: Direct substitution shows equality for all natural/do(r) cases and unequal u under the two off-natural do(k) cases; the executable checker exhausts the binary domain.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A mediator or localized cut is informative only under valid realization, fidelity, consistency and exclusion assumptions; finite tests do not reveal complete organization.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: All binary b and do(r) settings in the two fixed models; two off-natural do(k) settings supply discrimination.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: Observed variables in one token remain a finite view; causal equations are candidate abstract models until physically realized and grounded.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Expose dormant/mirrored/bypass states and motivate a same-token mediation witness.

nodes.label: Same-Token Installation Witness Contract
nodes.statement: For one actual P,I,K,D and internally sorted r,k,U, require jointly: W1 same-token actuality/typing and a fixed realization map; W2 report-independent physical Anchor grounding; W3 endogenous Bind and actually occurring Use; W4 fidelity-checked local perturbation propagation; W5 mediator or localized-cut discrimination from a live bypass under declared causal assumptions; and W6 bounded four-status discipline. The package is sufficient relative to its premises, not necessary and not a basal-experience criterion.
nodes.domain: One predeclared candidate Anchor-Bind-Use relation in one actual process token and nonzero interval; no actual apparatus or token was tested in R166.
nodes.scope: One predeclared candidate Anchor-Bind-Use relation in one actual process token and nonzero interval; no actual apparatus or token was tested in R166.
nodes.source_lineage: UCT I §8.11 physical-witness criterion plus R157 grounded selector and R159 Anchor-Bind-Use typing, with bypass discrimination made explicit.
nodes.proof: Definition of an application-level evidence package. All 64 Boolean clause assignments are checked; only the all-true assignment supports the contract conclusion.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Not necessary, not executed, not complete-mechanism identification, and vulnerable to invalid realization, locality or intervention assumptions. Missing clauses yield unresolved, not no experience.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: There exists one declared actual token/interval and candidate tuple; every W1-W6 clause and every member of nonempty U must satisfy the same binding package where applicable.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: P,I,K,D,r,k,U and instrument-to-occurrence map are fixed; population/session evidence, abstract equations, external anatomy and reports cannot replace them.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Provide a positive but bounded evidential bridge from finite protocol evidence to actual installed body-frame organization.

nodes.label: Witnessed Actual Body-Frame Installation
nodes.statement: If the same actual P,I,K,D satisfies the R157 physically grounded selector, the R159 sorted Anchor-Bind-Use schema and every R166 witness clause, then the selected theta_frame(r,k,U) is supported as actually installed during I. The conclusion is relative to the declared realization and causal assumptions and is not a complete-mechanism or necessity theorem.
nodes.domain: Exactly one common actual instance satisfying all three premise packages simultaneously; empirical truth of the clauses is not supplied by R166.
nodes.scope: Exactly one common actual instance satisfying all three premise packages simultaneously; empirical truth of the clauses is not supplied by R166.
nodes.source_lineage: Conditional application of R157/R159 to the new same-token witness; no general causal-identification novelty claimed.
nodes.proof: W1 fixes the instance and realization; W2-W3 supply actual grounded relation occurrences; W4-W5 discriminate use from the declared bypass; W6 restricts the conclusion and failure states.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Any false or unsupported witness premise blocks the conclusion. Alternative mechanisms outside the declared model and unmeasured redundancy remain open.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: For every application instance satisfying all premises on one common P,I,K,D and candidate tuple; no universal realization claim.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: All premises bind the identical actual bearer, interval, complete signature and sorted occurrences; no cross-trial h or population average is substituted.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Conditionally discharge the actual-installation gap while preserving empirical and type boundaries.

nodes.label: Experiential Body-Frame Counterpart, Familiar Mineness Still Open
nodes.statement: On the identical admitted P,I,K,D,Phi,h, a witnessed installed theta_frame is transported by the existing R159 C1 result to theta_frame(h(r),h(k),h(U)) in Phi. R157's semantic residual still blocks naming that counterpart familiar felt bodily mineness without independently fixed B_min and target evidence.
nodes.domain: One common actual C1 instance and selected installed relation; the conclusion does not range over tokens, populations or every experience.
nodes.scope: One common actual C1 instance and selected installed relation; the conclusion does not range over tokens, populations or every experience.
nodes.source_lineage: R159 frame transport plus R157 semantic residual, restricted by the new actual-installation result.
nodes.proof: Apply R159 transport to the witnessed relation on the same instance, then retain R157's model-preserving metalinguistic underdetermination.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not derive C1, validate B_min, identify familiar ownership/agency, require body-frame organization for experience, or assert a unique owner.

formal_contract_R166.object_domain: One selected body-frame relation on one declared actual token plus separately typed population evidence, finite views, experiential counterpart and semantic target.
formal_contract_R166.quantifiers: For every common instance satisfying witnessed installation and R159 transport; every familiar-label claim additionally requires independent B_min.
formal_contract_R166.bearer_time_signature: The D/Phi structures and h belong to the same P/I/K instance; external vocabulary, anatomy, measurement and report remain separately typed.
formal_contract_R166.purpose: Give a positive experience-internal organization route without a second owner or a semantic shortcut.

rules.statement: The grounded selector contract, typed Anchor-Bind-Use schema and every same-token witness clause jointly support the selected relation as actually installed on the one declared instance.
rules.proof_sketch: Bind all premises to one P/I/K/D tuple; W1-W3 establish actual typed occurrences and W4-W5 discriminate the declared active path from a bypass; W6 bounds status and conclusion.

bindings_required: same actual P and nonzero I
actual endogenous binding and consumer use
valid mediator/cut discrimination and declared causal assumptions
no report-defined role or basal-experience promotion
formal_contract_R166.quantification: Every clause must hold simultaneously on the same instance; population or cross-session evidence cannot fill a missing token premise by itself.

rules.statement: Witnessed actual installation and the existing same-instance C1 transport jointly yield an experiential structural counterpart, while the semantic residual jointly blocks a familiar-mineness label without B_min.
rules.proof_sketch: Apply R159's preservation biconditional to the witnessed tuple, then apply R157's unchanged-structure/different-label argument; neither direction supplies B_min.

bindings_required: same P/I/K/D/Phi/h across installation and transport
actual relation rather than population summary or finite view
C1 retained as consciousness-specific explanatory axiom
independent B_min required for familiar label
no unique owner or basal-experience threshold
formal_contract_R166.quantification: Every application is local to one common admitted C1 instance and one selected relation; no universal familiar-mineness interpretation follows.
